identificationModule.briefTitle: Anlotinib Plus TQB2450 Combined With Nab-paclitaxel and Cisplatin as First-line Treatment for Advanced Biliary Tract Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: The Efficacy and Safety of Anlotinib Plus TQB2450 Combined With Nab-paclitaxel and Cisplatin as First-line Treatment for Advanced Biliary Tract Cancer

leadSponsor.name: The First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of anlotinib plus TQB2450 combined with nab-paclitaxel and cisplatin as first-line treatment for advanced biliary tract cancer

interventions.name: anlotinib+TQB2450+nab-paclitaxel+cisplatin
interventions.description:
Anlotinib: 10mg, po, d1\~14, q3w, until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

TQB2450: 1200mg, ivgtt, d1, q3w, until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

nab-paclitaxel: 200mg/㎡, ivgtt, d1, q3w, 6 cycles. cisplatin: 60mg/㎡, ivgtt, d1, q3w, 6 cycles.

primaryOutcomes.description: The RECIST1.1 standards were used to evaluate the efficacy of drugs.

locations.facility: The First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University
